retrievalProfile.description: A surrealist, folk-art inspired composition featuring a central character integrated with board game elements like snakes, ladders, and a numbered grid.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, grotesque yet whimsical figure in red attire sits atop a multi-colored numbered grid. The figure is entwined with a snake and holds a banner containing stylized text, while a wooden ladder leans against the composition's right side.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure anchored by a rigid numbered grid background
Flowing banner typography contrasting with the geometric grid
Diagonal ladder and snake creating dynamic movement across the static background
Warm red and orange tones dominating the foreground against a cooler blue-toned grid
coreInvariants: A numbered grid background representing a game board
A central character wearing a hat and red clothing
The presence of both a snake and a ladder as physical elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The central figure occupies approximately 60% of the frame, centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The figure's wide, grinning face serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the curve of the top banner, down the snake's body, and up the diagonal ladder.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense and filled with texture and numbers.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central figure against a desaturated, weathered background.

letterConstructionRules: Letters are integrated into a flowing, ribbon-like banner
High contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals extend into sharp, thorn-like points
Counters are compressed to emphasize verticality
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Hand-drawn script paired with heavy, blocky decorative display type.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the decorative, high-contrast, and slightly grotesque feel.
Captures the fluid, warped nature of the banner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a surreal oil painting of a grinning clown-like figure in red clothes sitting on a weathered, numbered 1-100 grid board. Include a wooden ladder on the right and a snake coiling around the figure. Leave a curved, blank parchment banner at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered decorative serif text onto the banner, following its curved path with a dark brown, painted texture.

verificationChecks: Text follows the curve of the banner
Background grid is visible through the figure

mustAchieve: Cohesive integration of text and banner

postGenerationChecks: Does the banner feel physically part of the scene?
Is the color palette warm and aged?
Are the snake and ladder interacting with the figure?
